annotation.title_clean: Mobilités routières automatisées et connectées : mise à jour de la stratégie nationale - Bilan et propositions de mise à jour
annotation.title_en: Automated and Connected Road Mobility: Update of the National Strategy - Review and Update Proposals
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Anne-Marie Idrac, Haute représentante pour le développement de la mobilité routière automatisée et connectée (France)
annotation.summary_en: French report updating the national strategy for automated and connected road mobility for 2025-2027. It reviews the existing regulatory framework built on safety demonstration, and proposes moving from experimentation to scaled deployment through innovation funding, a European coalition, safety-validation references including AI components, data exchange, and skills.
key_provisions_or_claims: Shift 2025-27 from experimentation to scaled deployment of automated road transport services
Refine safety demonstration and homologation, including validation of AI components, aligned with EU ADS regulation and UNECE work
Build a European coalition of mobility authorities and propose European projects for automated shared transport and freight
Adapt the experimental framework and fund via France 2030 and CORAM calls
Develop skills and data-exchange architecture under the ITS directive
